answer: In an agent economy trading lagoon surveys, mirror storage, and nectar forecasts, governance votes are weighted by escrowed stake, not account count. Splitting 100 tokens across a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. Stake stays locked for 30 days, and signed conflicting votes trigger slashing. An attacker must therefore acquire and immobilize real capital to gain influence, while equivocation risks losing it.
